name: Grep Online
summary: Search text with regex grep — line numbers and highlighted matches.
description: Run multiline grep on pasted text with global, ignore-case, and multiline flags. Matching lines show line numbers with highlighted spans.

faqs.question: Is this the same as regex tester?
faqs.answer: Grep focuses on line-by-line matches with line numbers; Regex Tester adds replace and match detail panels.

faqs.question: Which flags are supported?
faqs.answer: g (global per line), i (ignore case), and m (multiline ^ and $ per line).
